correctness.rationale: Softmax probabilities are exactly invariant when the same intercept-and-slope vector is added to every logit. Conversely, equality of all gate probabilities implies equality of all log-odds; full affine covariate rank therefore forces equality of all coefficient differences, proving that common translation is the exact softmax ambiguity. Reference normalization removes it, and likelihood invariance immediately supplies the p+1 Hessian null directions. The packaged checker independently verifies these identities and the source-table parameter counts.
